  • Method Details

    • isAtLeast

      public static boolean isAtLeast(int major, int minor, int patch)
      Check if the server's current minecraft version is at least the specified version (inclusive).

      This method supports both semantic versioning (1.16, 1.18.2, 1.21.11) and future year-based versions (26.1, 26.1.1, 26.2, 26.2.3, 27.1).

      Parameters:
      major - The major version.
      minor - The minor version.
      patch - The patch version.
      Returns:
      Whether the server's current version is at least the specified version.
